general.description: Delri Base serves as an escort staging point for Adrimai exfiltration convoys from Irilia space to the 13-Planets League. Convoys going this way must be heavily escorted due to Gham Garri threat, the main routes to the Pupeteer Sphere passing only 3 jumps away from their Gham Dromae stronghold.
general.bar: Mainly Drih-marked pilots joking on their Gham Garri kills
